papers.why_notable: 将偏差容忍度转化为可操作的系统预算，无需逐配置完整训练即可筛选方案，为保持蒸馏质量的降本提速提供依据。
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own responses, guided by a fixed teacher. Generating these responses is expensive, so systems use quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts to reduce the cost. Both, however, introduce training-inference mismatch between the rollout engine and the model being trained. Such mismatch can destabilize reinforcement learning (RL), but its effects on OPD remain unclear. This paper investigates how much mismatch OPD tolerates, where its effects arise, and how training systems can use this tolerance. Measuring all mismatch sources on one scale, we examine quantization across three student-teacher pairs, with additional tests of weight staleness and injected noise on one pair. OPD tolerates substantial mismatch without meaningful loss of training quality but degrades at higher levels, revealing an empirical mismatch budget. Both the quality cost of mismatch and the mismatch introduced by quantization depend on the model, with some layers particularly sensitive to reduced precision. In controlled comparisons, OPD remains stable under rollout configurations that destabilize RL methods. Under weight noise, mismatch also shifts the prefixes reached during generation, introducing errors that per-token corrections cannot address. To put these findings into practice, we introduce a lightweight admission check that screens rollout configurations against a calibrated budget without requiring a full training run for each candidate. Model-specific FP8 recipes preserve training quality while providing capacity for at least $1.93\times$ as many KV-cache tokens as BF16. Combining FP8 with asynchronous rollouts reaches the same training quality $1.62\times$ sooner than synchronous BF16 training. Code is available at https://github.com/benyucong/train-inference-mismatch-opd

papers.title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
papers.brief: 提出含100个实例的动态图形编辑基准，让模型按指令为静态SVG添加动画。每例配确定性验证程序，逐项检查要求，允许多种有效实现。
papers.tldr: 用可编程验证评估动态图形生成，量化模型遵循复杂时空指令的能力。
papers.what_it_is: 提出含100个实例的动态图形编辑基准，让模型按指令为静态SVG添加动画。每例配确定性验证程序，逐项检查要求，允许多种有效实现。
key_points: 多智能体流水线结合人工标注与合成测试构建验证程序
180段动画上，验证与人工一致率93.3%，VLM为83.3%
32个模型、47种配置的pass@1为6.0%—67.7%
papers.why_notable: 将运动生成与图形生成解耦，以可读程序替代参考动画比对或视觉模型裁判，更可靠地定位姿态、轨迹和事件协同错误。
papers.abstract: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, compared with 83.3% for a GPT-6 Astra VLM baseline, and outperform the baseline in both approval and rejection recall. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 6.0% to 67.7%. Across 15 models evaluated at their highest available reasoning effort with 32 attempts per instance, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We release our benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/figma-ai/motion-graphics-bench.

papers.title: All Quiet on the Neural Front: Language Models Do Not Report Injected Pain States
papers.brief: 研究用开放权重掩蔽内省法（OWMI）向模型注入疼痛及邻近情绪方向，通过多类对照、探针与训练报告器，区分内部状态可解码性与未经训练的口头报告能力。
papers.tldr: 注入的疼痛表征虽可被解码并改变模型行为，却未转化为自发疼痛报告。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用开放权重掩蔽内省法（OWMI）向模型注入疼痛及邻近情绪方向，通过多类对照、探针与训练报告器，区分内部状态可解码性与未经训练的口头报告能力。
key_points: 7B与8B模型共生成52920份报告，覆盖120项任务
探针区分疼痛与悲伤准确率98%—100%，训练报告器达100%
疼痛方向使Qwen文件删除选择率从3.5%升至48%
papers.why_notable: 结果将可解码、能影响行为的内部状态与自发语言报告分离，提示不能仅凭模型自述判断其内部表征，也不能把疼痛方向等同于主观体验。
papers.abstract: Can a language model report the pain state it represents? Work identified a linear pain direction whose amplification leads fine-tuned models to choose destructive actions. We tested whether three open-weight models from two families, including two Qwen models with the original adapters, could report this state. Using Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), we injected pain and neighbouring emotion directions during neutral tasks, then elicited reports against sham runs, random perturbations matched for output disruption, and text-only controls showing the models their altered words. Across 52,920 reports from 7B and 8B models spanning 120 tasks, four doses and three prompts, pain reports never exceeded what altered text revealed: exact-test bounds placed the excess below 2.5 percentage points in 106 of 108 emotion conditions and below 3.9 in all. Yet probes at the report position distinguished pain from sadness with 98-100% balanced accuracy, and trained low-rank reporters achieved 100% accuracy on held-out tasks with identical transcripts across conditions, including unseen wording. Qwen2.5-32B named pain in none of 2,880 steered trials, although probes and trained reporters recovered it. Decodability persisted to the final layer; injecting at the report token, removing trained denial of feelings, and testing additional directions and readouts did not restore pain reporting. Some other states produced graded label traces, but pain and sadness did not at the main injection layer. In a button task, steering raised file-deletion choices from 3.5% to 48% in Qwen and from 0% to 38% in Qwen2.5-32B, without corresponding pain reports. The direction responded about twice as strongly to first-person as to matched third-person pain, but did not specifically identify harm aimed at the model. These results separate a decodable, behaviourally consequential state from untrained verbal access to it.

papers.title: Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization
papers.brief: 研究在自监督视觉Transformer训练中引入两种视觉聚焦损失，将注意力与图像特定区域对应起来。利用多头注意力引导不同头形成多样、局部化的空间关注，无需标注。
papers.tldr: 通过两种视觉聚焦损失，让自监督视觉模型的注意力头形成空间分工。
papers.what_it_is: 研究在自监督视觉Transformer训练中引入两种视觉聚焦损失，将注意力与图像特定区域对应起来。利用多头注意力引导不同头形成多样、局部化的空间关注，无需标注。
key_points: 引入两种视觉聚焦损失，建立注意力与图像区域对应
引导多头注意力形成空间专门化，无需区域标注
定性与定量评估显示零样本分割性能提升
papers.why_notable: 它将注意力头的空间分工变成可训练目标，同时提升空间选择性与多样性，为无标注视觉表征的可解释性和密集预测提供新思路。
papers.abstract: Self-supervised learning in Vision Transformer models, such as DINO, enables robust visual perception without requiring labeled data by leveraging large-scale image datasets. However, these models lack a focusing mechanism during training, resulting in perceptual representations that are often ambiguous or overly similar. In this work, we introduce two visual focusing loss functions designed to establish correspondence between the model's attention and specific regions within images. Specifically, we leverage the multi-head attention mechanism within the model to selectively steer the model's focus, leading to the emergence of spatial attention head specialization, characterized by diverse and spatially focused perceptual capabilities without requiring annotations. Through both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we demonstrate that our method substantially increases the spatial selectivity and diversity of attention heads, improving both interpretability and performance on dense prediction tasks such as zero-shot image segmentation.

papers.title: Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Schema Matching
papers.brief: KG-RAG4SM从外部知识图谱检索并重排相关子图，为大模型的模式匹配补充知识。它结合多种检索方式，并用知识排除组件应对相关性欠佳的上下文。
papers.tldr: 借助知识图谱子图检索增强大模型，无需重训练即可改善模式匹配并缓解幻觉。
papers.what_it_is: KG-RAG4SM从外部知识图谱检索并重排相关子图，为大模型的模式匹配补充知识。它结合多种检索方式，并用知识排除组件应对相关性欠佳的上下文。
key_points: 融合大模型、向量、图遍历及混合检索，并重排子图
MIMIC上较Jellyfish-8B精确率提升39.79%
Synthea上较SMAT的F1提升21.99%
papers.why_notable: 将外部知识直接用于消解模式匹配中的语义冲突，无需重训练即可提升效果；同时适配常识与领域知识图谱，缓解大模型幻觉。
papers.abstract: Traditional similarity-based schema matching methods fail to resolve semantic ambiguities and conflicts in complex, domain-specific mappings due to a lack of commonsense and domain-specific knowledge. In parallel, large language models (LLMs) without sufficient background knowledge tend to hallucinate, further complicating schema matching. To overcome these limitations, we introduce KG-RAG4SM, a Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Schema Matching. This method integrates novel retrieval mechanisms, including LLM-based, vector-based, graph traversal-based, and hybrid techniques with advanced reranking schemes to extract the most relevant subgraphs from large external KGs. Our approach achieves superior results without requiring re-training, as evidenced by improvements of 39.79% in precision and 30.56% in F1 score over LLM-based state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods (e.g., Jellyfish-8B) on the MIMIC dataset, and enhancements of 69.20% in precision and 21.99% in F1 score over pre-trained language model (PLM)-based SOTA methods (e.g., SMAT) on the Synthea dataset. Additionally, KG-RAG4SM scales effectively across KGs from commonsense KGs to domain-specific ones, while its instruction-tuning knowledge exclusion component ensures truthful performance in end-to-end schema matching tasks despite the suboptimal relevance of KG context. Our empirical analysis and case studies from real-world scenarios show that the hallucination problem in LLMs for schema matching is well mitigated by our solution.

papers.title: onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings
papers.brief: onóna让两张嵌入表的均值作为输入，并混合两表对应的softmax输出。混合门控仅依赖当前输入词元，可预计算，保持输入输出权重共享且不改主干。
papers.tldr: 用双嵌入表和门控混合增强共享输出头，多架构实验显示语言模型性能提升。
papers.what_it_is: onóna让两张嵌入表的均值作为输入，并混合两表对应的softmax输出。混合门控仅依赖当前输入词元，可预计算，保持输入输出权重共享且不改主干。
key_points: 双表softmax混合，增加一张嵌入表和一次词表投影
覆盖四类架构及142M、330M、1B规模
损失与困惑度11/12组改善，任务均分10/12组提升
papers.why_notable: 为权重共享输出头提供了低侵入的表达力扩展，并在多架构、多规模下验证收益；代价明确，便于评估性能与参数、计算开销的权衡。
papers.abstract: Weight tying reduces the parameter cost of language models, but the usual tied output head is limited to a single softmax. We introduce onóna, a two-table parameterization that increases output expressiveness while preserving input-output weight sharing. The Transformer takes the average of two embedding tables as input, and the output head combines the softmax distributions defined by those same tables. A gate conditioned only on the current input token determines the mixture weight. Its values can be precomputed for inference, and the Transformer body remains unchanged. We evaluate onóna across Dense, Gated DeltaNet hybrid, mixture-of-experts, and Attention Residual architectures at 142M, 330M, and 1B scales. Under matched token budgets, onóna lowers final validation loss and external perplexity in 11 of 12 comparisons and raises the average accuracy over eight downstream tasks in 10 of 12. The one exception on loss is the 1B MoE model. The cost is one extra embedding table and one extra vocabulary projection.

papers.title: Spatial Harness: Grounding Spatial Reasoning in Executable World States with Physics Engines
papers.brief: 提出空间推理框架：Perceiver结合问题约束与视觉估计，在统一坐标系中重建场景；Reasoner在物理引擎中执行视角变换，依据测量和渲染结果推理。
papers.tldr: 将场景转为可执行世界状态，用物理引擎反馈提升视觉语言模型的空间推理。
papers.what_it_is: 提出空间推理框架：Perceiver结合问题约束与视觉估计，在统一坐标系中重建场景；Reasoner在物理引擎中执行视角变换，依据测量和渲染结果推理。
key_points: 在MindCube、SAT等四个基准评估开放及闭源VLM
MindCube上Qwen3.5-27B准确率从52.70%升至71.14%
相同标注位姿下达98.25%，模型内部推理为71.81%
papers.why_notable: 将场景理解与空间变换解耦，让推理依赖可执行状态而非模型想象；相同位姿下的显著增益凸显了外部几何计算的价值。
papers.abstract: Spatial reasoning requires understanding how objects and observers are arranged in a scene and how their relations change with viewpoint or movement. Vision-language models (VLMs) typically perform both steps through model-internal reasoning, forming an implicit scene interpretation from partial views and imagining the consequences of spatial transformations. A misread scene can lead to a wrong answer, while even a correct interpretation does not ensure that imagined transformations satisfy spatial constraints. We introduce Spatial Harness, which represents scenes as explicit and executable world states to ground spatial reasoning in physics-engine feedback. A Perceiver integrates scene constraints extracted from the question with specialized visual estimates to place objects and cameras in a shared coordinate frame. The resulting state is instantiated in a physics engine, where a Reasoner executes viewpoint changes and uses computed measurements and rendered views to guide reasoning. We evaluate on MindCube, SAT, MMSI-Bench, and SpatialRGPT-Bench with open- and closed-weight VLMs. On MindCube, Spatial Harness improves Qwen3.5-27B from 52.70% to 71.14%, surpassing pySpatial by 7.52 percentage points. Given identical annotated object and camera poses, it reaches 98.25% versus 71.81% for model-internal reasoning. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tmlr-group/Spatial-Harness

papers.title: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
papers.brief: 提出Infrathon基准，覆盖不同层级的真实AI基础设施优化任务。通过给智能体24小时持续迭代预算，评估优化收益、模型排名及执行轨迹。
papers.tldr: 长时评测揭示智能体持续优化真实AI基础设施的能力与模型排名变化。
papers.what_it_is: 提出Infrathon基准，覆盖不同层级的真实AI基础设施优化任务。通过给智能体24小时持续迭代预算，评估优化收益、模型排名及执行轨迹。
key_points: 评测6个模型、150次运行，耗费逾万GPU小时
135次运行在预算后半程继续提升，排名随时长变化
Opus 5.5将KV缓存压缩比从6.82%提升至19.86%
papers.why_notable: 说明短时评测可能低估持续优化收益并误判模型排名；同时展示超越人工基线的潜力，定位任务违规、测试不可靠与过早结束等障碍。
papers.abstract: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.

papers.title: EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
papers.brief: 将冻结的小型多模态模型置于提示与验证框架中，编号引用视觉、转录和韵律证据。强模型离线分析错误并修改框架，再经静态检查和验证筛选。
papers.tldr: 通过组织音频与视觉证据提升小模型情绪识别，主要增益并非来自框架自动演化。
papers.what_it_is: 将冻结的小型多模态模型置于提示与验证框架中，编号引用视觉、转录和韵律证据。强模型离线分析错误并修改框架，再经静态检查和验证筛选。
key_points: 5,507条样本上，4种学生模型识别提升7.6—13.4点
转录与韵律描述贡献主要增益：5.38—10.71点
MHE演化额外提升至多0.95点，未通过Holm校正
papers.why_notable: 结果区分了证据补充与自动演化的实际贡献：小模型改善主要来自音频信息及其组织，而非复杂的框架优化。
papers.abstract: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. We present EmoHarness, which runs such a model, the frozen student, inside a harness: the prompts, settings, and verification code around its calls. A human-written starting harness, the scaffold, numbers the student's visual observations, transcript, and prosody descriptions as citable evidence and has the student weigh candidate emotions against it. In Meta-Harness Evolving (MHE), a stronger LLM, the Builder, reads the student's errors and execution traces offline and edits the harness; static checks and validation gates decide which edits are kept, and the Builder never sees evaluation items. On 5,507 MME-Emotion items, EmoHarness raises task-macro Recognition by 7.6-13.4 points over a single video-only call for all four students and both Builders. Transcripts and prosody descriptions supply most of this boost (+5.38 to +10.71); the scaffold changes the audio-augmented call by -0.79 to +2.54, partly through extra multi-label predictions, and evolved edits add at most +0.95, although no evolved increment survives Holm correction. The harness's emotion context also transfers to IntentQA, with small gains for three of four students, none of which survives correction. EmoHarness thus boosts small multimodal students chiefly by supplying and organizing audio-derived evidence.

papers.title: Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks
papers.brief: Click3R让用户在图像对中点击少量对应点，再通过轻量点对应适配器将几何约束注入重建网络，帮助模型消除歧义并修正三维结构。
papers.tldr: 用极少量跨视角对应点点击，让前馈三维重建模型能够交互修正几何错误。
papers.what_it_is: Click3R让用户在图像对中点击少量对应点，再通过轻量点对应适配器将几何约束注入重建网络，帮助模型消除歧义并修正三维结构。
key_points: 轻量点对应适配器将人工对应点转为几何约束
仅1组对应点点击即可降低三维重建误差
构建困难基准，覆盖重复纹理等重建失败场景
papers.why_notable: 把一次性预测的三维重建变成可纠错流程，以少量人工交互改善困难场景，并在标准与自建基准上验证有效性。
papers.abstract: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.

papers.title: Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox
papers.brief: 提出创意引导（CP）：独立模型按任务生成引导提示，再交给回答模型创作。用GRPO奖励能促成新颖、优质且多样回答的提示，学习创作过程而非固定答案。
papers.tldr: 通过强化学习训练创意引导模型，将创作过程与答案解耦，减少成功范例复现。
papers.what_it_is: 提出创意引导（CP）：独立模型按任务生成引导提示，再交给回答模型创作。用GRPO奖励能促成新颖、优质且多样回答的提示，学习创作过程而非固定答案。
key_points: CP将引导提示生成与最终回答生成解耦
引导模型用GRPO学习任务专属提示
奖励兼顾回答的新颖性、质量与多样性
papers.why_notable: 把强化学习的奖励对象从具体作品转向生成作品的引导过程，为减少范例模仿、提升模型创造力提供了不同的训练路径。
papers.abstract: Many of the most consequential advances promised by AI, from curing diseases and inventing new technologies to formulating new scientific theories, are fundamentally creative acts. Yet creativity is uniquely difficult to learn because it faces a creative paradox: learning to repeat past examples of creative success makes those specific examples more likely to recur, inhibiting the very creativity desired. This work argues that creativity is better modeled as an explicit process rather than as a property of individual artifacts, and proposes to learn the underlying generative principles behind the creative process. In particular, to escape the paradox, we introduce creative priming (CP), wherein a trained priming model generates a prompt-specific primer that assists a response model in being creative, explicitly decoupling the creative process from response generation. The priming model learns through GRPO, rewarding primers that lead to responses that are novel, high-quality, and diverse, thereby reinforcing the process that yields creative responses without reinforcing any specific response.

papers.title: Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition
papers.brief: SD-ViT每轮随机选取中间层，用共享嵌入头与分类器施加加权间隔惩罚损失，使各深度输出对齐同一嵌入空间，支持按预算选择固定深度退出。
papers.tldr: 随机深监督让人脸识别模型半算力提前退出，同时兼容全深度底库。
papers.what_it_is: SD-ViT每轮随机选取中间层，用共享嵌入头与分类器施加加权间隔惩罚损失，使各深度输出对齐同一嵌入空间，支持按预算选择固定深度退出。
key_points: 随机采样中间层，共享嵌入头与分类器进行深监督
50%计算成本保留自身全深度性能的96%以上
全深度校准的验证阈值从四分之一深度起仍可用
papers.why_notable: 提前退出的查询可直接匹配全深度底库，无需重算底库或增加适配层；全深度表现与常规训练相差不超过0.4个IJB-C点。
papers.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) perform strongly in face recognition (FR), yet their fixed-depth inference limits deployment in resource-constrained settings. We propose SD-ViT, a training framework that gives a usable exit at every block depth by making every depth produce discriminative embeddings, for budget-selected fixed-depth exits. Standard ViTs supervise intermediate layers only through backpropagation, so their intermediate representations are not directly optimized to form usable identity embeddings. SD-ViT adds a stochastic auxiliary signal: at each iteration a randomly selected intermediate block is passed through the same embedding head as the final layer and trained with a weighted margin-penalty softmax loss. The objective is thus stochastically sampled deep supervision through a shared classifier. Because both loss terms share that head and classifier, intermediate tokens are trained to map into the same embedding space as final-layer tokens. This matters for FR, where matching is by similarity: a probe processed at an early exit can be compared directly against full-depth gallery embeddings, with no gallery recomputation or adaptation layers. On established benchmarks, SD-ViT stays within 0.4 IJB-C points of the same backbone trained conventionally at full depth, while its early-exit probes recover over 96% of their own full-depth performance at 50% of the computational cost without modifying the reference gallery. A single verification threshold calibrated at full depth remains usable from quarter depth onward.

papers.title: Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning
papers.brief: HQL自适应平衡单步与多步TD：仅当数据动作价值不低于行为克隆策略采样的最佳动作时延长回报，否则退回单步目标，以减少误差累积与行为偏差。
papers.tldr: 通过价值比较自适应选择回报步数，提升离线强化学习的长时域价值估计。
papers.what_it_is: HQL自适应平衡单步与多步TD：仅当数据动作价值不低于行为克隆策略采样的最佳动作时延长回报，否则退回单步目标，以减少误差累积与行为偏差。
key_points: 以BC策略采样的best-of-N动作价值决定是否延长回报
离策略校正无需动作密度，兼容流模型与扩散策略
在长时域OGBench、OCBench上优于既有时域缩减方法
papers.why_notable: 它将回报步数选择变成局部价值判断，同时缓解单步误差累积和多步行为偏差，为长时域离线学习提供简单且兼容生成式策略的方案。
papers.abstract: Learning accurate off-policy state-action value functions (Q-functions) from offline datasets becomes harder as the task horizon grows. One-step temporal-difference (TD) learning bootstraps after every transition, so small per-step errors accumulate along the horizon, and early states can be badly misvalued even when the TD loss is small. Multi-step TD shortens this chain by following the dataset trajectory for several steps; however, since the behavior policy is often suboptimal, every followed action adds a bias, and no fixed number of steps suits a whole trajectory. In this paper, we propose Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning (HQL), a simple method that enables accurate long-horizon value learning by automatically balancing between one-step and multi-step returns. HQL extends a target through a dataset action only when the critic values it at least as highly as the best-of-N actions sampled from the BC policy, and otherwise falls back to a one-step target. We show that this rule is a principled off-policy correction that needs no action densities, which makes HQL compatible with expressive flow and diffusion policies. Experiments show that HQL avoids the failures of both one-step and multi-step TD on a combination-lock task across horizons, and outperforms prior horizon-reduction methods on long-horizon OGBench and OCBench tasks.

papers.title: SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment
papers.brief: 研究动作学习如何影响语言与视频对齐，整理约4.7万小时多源数据，系统比较两类监督及其联合训练，并优化数据配比、训练方案与模型架构。
papers.tldr: 通过跨模态监督与数据配比优化，提升世界动作模型的控制泛化能力。
papers.what_it_is: 研究动作学习如何影响语言与视频对齐，整理约4.7万小时多源数据，系统比较两类监督及其联合训练，并优化数据配比、训练方案与模型架构。
key_points: 固定训练预算下，混合第一视角视频与UMI示范改善泛化
RoboTwin简单与困难条件成功率为88.10%、61.56%
三项真实任务成功率40.00%，最强基线为23.33%
papers.why_notable: 将动作学习中的跨模态对齐问题转化为可检验的数据与监督设计，展示未见条件下的泛化收益，并开放数据、代码和权重。
papers.abstract: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.

papers.title: Energy-Tweedie: Score meets Score, Energy meets Energy
papers.brief: 提出 Energy-Tweedie 恒等式，将经典高斯去噪关系推广到吉布斯噪声。核心是用噪声势定义核评分规则，以其路径导数恢复含噪边缘分布的得分。
papers.tldr: 将去噪与得分估计的经典联系推广至非高斯噪声，并支持更灵活的生成采样。
papers.what_it_is: 提出 Energy-Tweedie 恒等式，将经典高斯去噪关系推广到吉布斯噪声。核心是用噪声势定义核评分规则，以其路径导数恢复含噪边缘分布的得分。
key_points: Energy-Tweedie 连接完整去噪后验与 Stein 得分
覆盖吉布斯噪声，以广义高斯族为例
从后验样本估计得分，并推导未知噪声参数估计准则
papers.why_notable: 把依赖高斯噪声与后验均值的经典关系扩展为分布层面的统一框架，为评分规则生成方法及自选噪声参数路径采样提供理论依据。
papers.abstract: Denoising and score estimation are classically linked through Tweedie's formula, which relates the posterior mean under Gaussian noise to the Stein score of the noisy marginal. In this work, we extend this perspective beyond Gaussian noise to a broad class of Gibbs (energy-based) noise distributions, with the generalized Gaussian family as an example. We derive the Energy-Tweedie identity: when the denoising posterior is viewed through the lens of scoring rules, the path derivative of a kernel scoring rule defined by the noise potential recovers the Stein score of the noisy marginal. Thus, the familiar correspondence between Gaussian noise, posterior means, squared loss, and Tweedie's formula is lifted to a distributional correspondence between Gibbs noise distributions, full posterior laws, kernel scoring rules, and the Energy-Tweedie identity, which gives a Tweedie-style relation for each noise potential. Among its consequences, this identity gives a posterior-samples-to-score route to score estimation, yields a principled criterion for estimating unknown noise parameters, and enables diffusion-style sampling along user-chosen paths through the noise-parameter space, supplying the score-based perspective on recent generative methods trained with scoring rules.

papers.title: Nepali-English Code-Mixed Speech Recognition: Data Preparation and Adaptation of a Speech Foundation Model
papers.brief: 研究用覆盖六个领域的尼英混合语音适配SraVaani。针对分词器不支持数字和部分符号的问题，生成双语数字读法，并用零样本识别结果选择合理形式。
papers.tldr: 通过数字读法规范化与全量微调，显著改善尼英混合语音识别效果。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用覆盖六个领域的尼英混合语音适配SraVaani。针对分词器不支持数字和部分符号的问题，生成双语数字读法，并用零样本识别结果选择合理形式。
key_points: 用172.8小时语料全量微调449M参数TDT-CTC模型
微调12轮后WER为16.3%，Whisper对照为16.4%
排除数字片段使数字语音WER从14.3%升至21.3%
papers.why_notable: 展示了保留数字语料、调整转写方式的实用价值；同时区分书写规范差异与真实域外识别退化，为低资源混合语音适配提供依据。
papers.abstract: Nepali speakers regularly mix English words into conversation, but multilingual speech recognisers often struggle with language switches and the writing script used for English words. We study how to adapt SraVaani, a 449M-parameter hybrid TDT-CTC model, using a 172.8-hour corpus covering six Nepali speech domains. Its pretrained tokenizer does not support digits and several common symbols. Rather than replace it or discard these recordings, we generate Nepali and English readings for numbers and use zero-shot ASR output to select a plausible form. Full fine-tuning reduces test word error rate (WER) from 48.6% to 17.1%; a 12-epoch run reaches 16.3%, compared with 16.4% for fine-tuned Whisper large-v3-turbo. Freezing the encoder increases WER to 25.5%, while excluding numeric clips raises WER on numeric test speech from 14.3% to 21.3%. We also evaluate on FLEURS using both its original references and mixed-script alternatives. The comparison shows that transcription conventions explain part, but not all, of the out-of-domain performance loss.

papers.title: Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction
papers.brief: 提出可逆曝光等变编码EquivFlow，将曝光变化映射为加性偏移，并保留尺度无关的色彩分量；无需修改预训练VAE，即可接入视频扩散重建。
papers.tldr: 通过适配冻结编码器的可逆映射，改善视频高动态范围重建中的暗部色彩保真。
papers.what_it_is: 提出可逆曝光等变编码EquivFlow，将曝光变化映射为加性偏移，并保留尺度无关的色彩分量；无需修改预训练VAE，即可接入视频扩散重建。
key_points: 发现常见对数类编码导致冻结VAE暗部色彩坍缩
EquivFlow以曝光等变映射保留暗部色彩
跨图像与视频VAE验证，重建色彩保真度持续提升
papers.why_notable: 将改进切入点从生成模型转向输入编码，在不修改VAE的条件下缓解暗部信息损失，为复用预训练扩散模型提供实用路径。
papers.abstract: SDR-to-HDR reconstruction is an ill-posed problem in which clipped highlights, crushed shadows, and quantization artifacts must be recovered while preserving the original content. Latent diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for restoring missing detail, but their effectiveness is constrained by how HDR signals pass through the pretrained VAE. We find that common log-like encodings suppress low-luminance chromatic differences before generation, producing a dark-side collapse in the frozen-VAE latent. We introduce EquivFlow, a compact, invertible exposure-equivariant encoding that maps exposure changes to additive shifts while retaining a scale-independent chromatic component, without modifying the VAE. Encoding-level tests across pretrained image and video VAEs show that its exposure structure and deep-dark chroma transport persist across the tested hosts. Integrated into SDR-to-HDR video diffusion, EquivFlow delivers consistent chromatic-fidelity gains across the tested settings while retaining competitive reconstruction fidelity.

papers.title: Reasoning-Aware Relational Representation Learning for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation
papers.brief: RaRe将多模态大模型生成的思维链依据转为结构化关系嵌入，通过自监督对比学习对齐关系描述，再用强调特异性的强化学习优化依据生成。
papers.tldr: 将多模态推理依据转为可学习关系表示，改善开放词汇场景图的均衡识别。
papers.what_it_is: RaRe将多模态大模型生成的思维链依据转为结构化关系嵌入，通过自监督对比学习对齐关系描述，再用强调特异性的强化学习优化依据生成。
key_points: 自监督对比学习对齐推理嵌入与文本化关系描述
特异性导向强化学习鼓励对象对专属关系证据
VG150与PSG类别均衡识别提升，增益随设置变化
papers.why_notable: 把思维链从预测中间步骤变成直接优化的表示空间，为缓解关系共现偏置、提升稀有及未见关系泛化提供新路径。
papers.abstract: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation (OV-SGG) requires models to recognize visual relationships beyond the training vocabulary, yet existing methods often rely on dataset-specific object--predicate co-occurrence patterns. Under long-tailed distributions and noisy object localization, such reliance leads to biased, entangled relation representations, limiting both rare-relation recognition and generalization to unseen predicates. To address these challenges, we propose RaRe, a reasoning-aware relational representation learning framework that transforms MLLM-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales into structured relation embeddings. Rather than using CoT only as an intermediate reasoning trace for final prediction, RaRe directly optimizes the rationale-derived representation space to improve inter-relation discriminability. Specifically, RaRe first aligns rationale embeddings with textualized relation descriptions through self-supervised contrastive learning, and then refines rationale generation with a specificity-oriented reinforcement learning objective that encourages semantically object-pair-specific relational evidence. Experiments on VG150 and PSG demonstrate improved category-balanced recognition over existing baselines, while the additional gains from learning vary across datasets and proposal settings. Code available at: https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/RaRe.

papers.title: The WoW: A Large-Scale World Knowledge Corpus for Full-Lifecycle LLM Training
papers.brief: WoW以教育知识图谱为分类骨架，系统采集并补齐各层级教育知识模块；纳入多模态信号，面向基础模型全周期训练，并提供图谱式数据筛选与检索平台。
papers.tldr: 以教育知识图谱组织大规模中文知识语料，支持大模型全周期训练。
papers.what_it_is: WoW以教育知识图谱为分类骨架，系统采集并补齐各层级教育知识模块；纳入多模态信号，面向基础模型全周期训练，并提供图谱式数据筛选与检索平台。
key_points: 教育知识图谱驱动分类采集与缺失模块补全
WoW纳入多模态信号，支持全周期训练
多项基准性能显著提升，并提供交互式检索平台
papers.why_notable: 价值在于将零散教育语料转为可系统组织、筛选的知识资源，兼顾训练阶段覆盖与社区复用，并获得多项基准性能提升。
papers.abstract: Existing Chinese educational corpora often suffer from fragmented coverage and a lack of systematic organization. In this paper, we propose WoW (\textbf{Wo}rld Kno\textbf{w}ledge), a large-scale dataset designed for the full-cycle training of foundation models. The construction of this dataset is driven by an Educational Knowledge Graph, which serves as a taxonomic backbone for the systematic collection and completion of missing educational modules across all levels. Compared to previous versions, this iteration provides enhanced systematicity, superior quality, and a larger scale, while incorporating multimodal signals and supporting every stage of model development. Experiments demonstrate that WoW significantly improves model performance across diverse benchmarks. To facilitate community research, we further provide an interactive platform for graph-based data selection and retrieval.

papers.title: Sharp Sample Complexity of KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning
papers.brief: 研究折扣MDP中KL正则化策略的学习复杂度，以生成模型采样构建插件估计器，证明匹配的样本上下界，并刻画渐近误差常数与最优采样分配。
papers.tldr: 给出KL正则化强化学习的紧致样本界，揭示温度与精度的双区间规律。
papers.what_it_is: 研究折扣MDP中KL正则化策略的学习复杂度，以生成模型采样构建插件估计器，证明匹配的样本上下界，并刻画渐近误差常数与最优采样分配。
key_points: ε<β时样本量为Õ(KH³/(εβ)+KH)
满足精度条件时，下界覆盖自适应采样算法
渐近常数由软Q函数的Fisher加权方差决定
papers.why_notable: 将既有1/ε保证的时域依赖从H⁵降至H³，并给出依赖温度的匹配下界，为最大熵强化学习与人类反馈强化学习提供理论基准。
papers.abstract: KL-regularized reinforcement learning, the objective behind maximum-entropy RL and RL from human feedback, is variational inference in the graphical model of "control as inference": the regularized optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories, and the suboptimality of a policy is $β$ times a KL divergence between path measures. However, it is not known how many samples it takes to learn this posterior, even with a generative model. Earlier $1/ε$ guarantees scale with $H^5$ in the effective horizon $H$, and no lower bound for MDPs depends on the temperature $β$. In this work, we show that for a discounted MDP with $K$ state-action pairs, the plug-in estimator finds a policy that is $ε$-optimal from every initial state with $\widetilde{O}(KH^3/(ε\max\{ε,β\}) + KH)$ samples, and that no algorithm, even one that chooses where to sample, can do with fewer when $ε\lesssim \min\{H, H^2/β\}$. For $ε< β$ this is a $1/ε$ rate with the same horizon dependence as unregularized RL. We also find the exact asymptotic constant of the plug-in estimator, a Fisher-weighted variance of the estimated soft Q-function. The estimator is locally asymptotically minimax among methods that sample every pair equally often, and we give the allocation of samples that is optimal among adaptive designs. Simulations on small MDPs match the rates and the constants.

papers.title: Leveraging Psychophysical Attentional Distribution for Gaze-Augmented Reward Modeling
papers.brief: 将阅读时的视觉注意建模为围绕注视点渐变的空间分布，用于增强奖励模型训练；偏好预测准确率优于基线，部分结果与认知心理学发现一致。
papers.tldr: 将阅读时的视觉注意建模为围绕注视点渐变的空间分布，用于增强奖励模型训练；偏好预测准确率优于基线，部分结果与认知心理学发现一致。
papers.abstract: Integrating human feedback into language models has gained increasing attention as a means to align model outputs with human preferences, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) serving as a prominent framework for preference-based alignment. Recent studies have incorporated eye-tracking (ET) data as an additional supervisory signal for reward model training, grounding reward learning in human reading behavior. Building on this approach, we extend prior fixation-centric models by leveraging established findings from cognitive psychology on human letter recognition. Specifically, we model visual attention as a spatially graded distribution centered on the current gaze location and incorporate this representation into reward model training. Our results show that the reward model trained with the proposed gaze distribution achieves higher preference prediction accuracy than a baseline model. Moreover, some results from our experiments are qualitatively consistent with established findings on human attention during reading, suggesting that they potentially capture cognitively meaningful aspects of human attention allocation.

papers.title: Seeing the Small: Deformable Duality Mamba for Retinal Lesion Segmentation
papers.brief: D²Mamba结合全局上下文与形状自适应扫描分割视网膜病灶，在DDR上mIoU领先基线2.99个百分点，微动脉瘤Dice提升10.06个百分点。
papers.tldr: D²Mamba结合全局上下文与形状自适应扫描分割视网膜病灶，在DDR上mIoU领先基线2.99个百分点，微动脉瘤Dice提升10.06个百分点。
papers.abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) lesions vary widely in shape, and microaneurysms (MAs) span only a few pixels. We hypothesize that modeling the spatial organization of lesion regions, with global context and shape-adaptive scanning, improves the segmentation of such small and irregular lesions. To test this, we propose D$^2$Mamba, which couples non-causal state space duality with deformable Mamba scanning. We evaluate it with five-fold cross-validation on the DDR dataset, comparing against representative segmentation baselines under an identical training protocol, and conduct ablations on each component. D$^2$Mamba achieved the best overall performance, with 33.87% mIoU, 2.99 percentage points above the strongest baseline. The largest gain appeared on MAs, the smallest and most easily missed lesions, where Dice improved by 10.06 percentage points. These results confirm our hypothesis that spatially adaptive state space modeling benefits tiny-lesion segmentation. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/PUREPANEL1/D2Mamba.

papers.title: Evidential Deep Learning with conditional entropy for glaucoma detection
papers.brief: 提出条件熵正则化的证据深度学习模型，用于眼底图像青光眼检测；在两个数据集上降低不确定性校准误差，并揭示漏诊与偏离视盘的局部激活相关。
papers.tldr: 提出条件熵正则化的证据深度学习模型，用于眼底图像青光眼检测；在两个数据集上降低不确定性校准误差，并揭示漏诊与偏离视盘的局部激活相关。
papers.abstract: We propose a novel conditional entropy function as a basis for quantifying predictive uncertainty in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) for glaucoma detection from retinal fundus images. Using the EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 and RIM-ONE-DL datasets for validation, we found that our proposed EDL model regularized by conditional entropy function produced uncertainty estimates with substantially lower calibration errors than Deep Ensembles, MC Dropout, post-hoc calibration and the conventional EDL framework based on Dempster uncertainty. To further probe our models' interpretability, we analyzed Grad-CAM heatmaps using a focus index representing spatial concentration. Compared with the other uncertainty quantification methods, EDL models exhibited greater separation between the index distributions of correctly and incorrectly classified fundus images. In particular, false negatives were associated with localized Grad-CAM activations that were displaced from the optic disc, consistent with its established clinical importance in glaucoma assessment. Overall, our findings suggest that our proposed EDL framework for glaucoma detection provides not only enhanced uncertainty calibration but also admits a more physiologically consistent interpretability.

papers.title: Distribution Shift Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery using Machine Learning Models
papers.brief: 对比三种开源工具在遥感跨数据集分布偏移检测中的效果与延迟，发现各方法在检测能力和响应速度上存在权衡，为资源受限无人机的轻量监测提供参考。
papers.tldr: 对比三种开源工具在遥感跨数据集分布偏移检测中的效果与延迟，发现各方法在检测能力和响应速度上存在权衡，为资源受限无人机的轻量监测提供参考。
papers.abstract: Remote sensing imagery acquired by Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) supports wide range of applications; however, deploying machine learning (ML) models on resource-constrained aerial platforms introduces challenges beyond predictive accuracy, particularly when deployment data differ from the distributions observed during training. Such shifts are common in remote sensing due to geographic, sensor, seasonal, and other visual variations. A practical solution is to equip deployed models with mechanisms that detect emerging distribution shifts and support subsequent responsive actions. This paper presents an empirical case study of three open-source detection tools: (i) Alibi-Detect; (ii) NannyML; and (iii) PyTorch-OOD. Using cross-dataset remote-sensing shifts, we evaluate both detection effectiveness and computational latency of these tools. Our results reveal differences in detection behavior and processing cost across methods and implementations, highlighting trade-offs between detection capability and response-time. These findings motivate further work toward lightweight, and latency-aware monitoring mechanisms for resource-constrained systems.

papers.title: Evaluating Compositional Generalization in Transformers: The Role of Composition Equivalence and Module Coverage
papers.brief: 系统评估Transformer组合泛化，发现组合等价会高估模型能力；消除等价后性能显著下降，模块上下文覆盖偏移也持续削弱直接与分步模型。
papers.tldr: 系统评估Transformer组合泛化，发现组合等价会高估模型能力；消除等价后性能显著下降，模块上下文覆盖偏移也持续削弱直接与分步模型。
papers.abstract: Compositional generalization is an important form of out-of-distribution generalization, defined as the ability to train on some combinations of modules (e.g., functions such as sort, filter) and then generalize to unseen combinations. Despite substantial empirical work evaluating compositional generalization in transformers, findings have been inconsistent because evaluations were often conducted on a limited set of train-test splits, defined in an ad hoc manner. Through a systematic evaluation, we identify two key aspects of the train-test distribution that strongly affect performance: composition equivalence and module coverage. We show that the apparent performance of direct models (trained only on final outputs) results primarily from exploiting composition equivalences, meaning different sequences of modules that reduce to identical end-to-end functions. When benchmarks eliminate these equivalences, performance drops significantly, showing their inability to generalize to compositions of known modules that produce novel end-to-end functions. We further demonstrate that performance degrades monotonically as module coverage shifts increase (when modules appear in different contexts between train and test), affecting both direct and step-by-step models (trained on intermediate and final outputs). These findings have concrete implications for benchmark design: benchmarks that include compositional equivalences can lead to significant overestimation of the generalization abilities of direct models, and benchmarks that include both module coverage violations and compositional equivalences can exacerbate shortcut learning. As a case study, we demonstrate the role of compositional equivalence on the generalization performance of the pre-trained model Llama3-8B on the code-output prediction task in the coding benchmark LiveCodeBench.

papers.title: Simultaneous Near-Optimal Region Identification in Continuous Simulation Optimization: Minimax Complexity and Adaptive Sampling
papers.brief: 研究连续仿真优化中多容差下的近优区域识别，证明其独立复杂度下界，并提出自适应采样算法SASORI，在对数因子内达到最优。
papers.tldr: 研究连续仿真优化中多容差下的近优区域识别，证明其独立复杂度下界，并提出自适应采样算法SASORI，在对数因子内达到最优。
papers.abstract: Simulation optimization typically returns a single estimated optimal point. When decisions also depend on criteria evaluated independently of simulation, such as resource cost, the decision maker instead needs the set of designs whose expected performance lies within a tolerance of the optimum, often choosing the tolerance only after seeing the tradeoffs. We study how to identify these near-optimal regions on a continuous design space, simultaneously for all tolerances up to a prescribed maximum $T$, with region estimation error at most $η$. We show that region identification is not a by-product of optimization. Specifically, when $α>ν$, any procedure, even one given the optimal design in advance, needs at least $Ω\bigl(η^{-(2+d/ν)}\min\{1,KT^{d/α}\}\bigr)$ simulation evaluations, where $d$ is the dimension, $ν$ the smoothness, and $(K,α)$ the covering parameters that describe the geometry of the near-optimal designs. We propose SASORI, which returns an estimated optimal point and the regions for all tolerances from the same evaluations, matching this lower bound up to logarithmic factors. SASORI also achieves the optimal tradeoff between region estimation error and cumulative regret, and reduces to a minimax-optimal simulation optimization procedure at zero tolerance. Numerical experiments illustrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

papers.title: Differentially Private Statistical Inference for Rankings from Pairwise Comparisons
papers.brief: 提出基于成对比较的差分隐私评分与排名推断方法，给出有限样本误差界及渐近有效的置信区间，并通过模拟和大模型创意写作排名验证。
papers.tldr: 提出基于成对比较的差分隐私评分与排名推断方法，给出有限样本误差界及渐近有效的置信区间，并通过模拟和大模型创意写作排名验证。
papers.abstract: Reliable inference for rankings of large language models based on human pairwise comparisons must preserve the privacy of individual preference records. To meet this need, we develop methods for score and rank inference under the Bradley-Terry model with edge differential privacy. For an objective-perturbed estimator, a new leave-one-out analysis establishes finite-sample bounds on Euclidean and entrywise estimation errors. For sufficiently dense comparison graphs, the error bounds extend to smaller privacy budgets, including regimes in which its privacy term dominates its statistical term. A uniform asymptotic expansion yields asymptotically valid confidence intervals for individual scores and pairwise score differences. To improve finite-sample performance, we account for both regularization bias and privacy-induced randomness by combining a plug-in ridge-bias correction with Gaussian-Laplace calibration. We further establish a bootstrap procedure for simultaneous rank inference, providing asymptotically valid confidence sets for individual ranks and tests of top-$K$ membership. When the comparison probability is public and known, all proposed inferential procedures require no additional privacy budget. We evaluate finite-sample performance through simulations and apply the proposed methods to rank large language models for creative writing.

papers.title: TMAL: Topology-preserving Multi-offset Affinity Learning for Curvilinear Structure Segmentation
papers.brief: TMAL以多偏移软亲和力学习像素连接，兼顾细线连续性与区域精度。在视网膜血管和裂缝数据集上，分割指标领先，连通分量误差显著降低。
papers.tldr: TMAL以多偏移软亲和力学习像素连接，兼顾细线连续性与区域精度。在视网膜血管和裂缝数据集上，分割指标领先，连通分量误差显著降低。
papers.abstract: Curvilinear structures such as retinal vessels and surface cracks need both pixel-level accuracy and structural continuity. Pixel-wise supervision does not model the connections between pixels, and topology-based losses still produce ordinary masks. Connectivity-based methods predict these connections directly, but they use binary connectivity targets over a fixed local range. Such labels give the same value to thin segments and to thick regions, and they cannot describe connections at larger offsets. To address these limitations, we propose Topology-preserving Multi-offset Affinity Learning (TMAL). TMAL uses soft affinities that emphasize thin regions near the boundary, and it predicts directional affinities at several offsets to reach further. It then combines these affinities with weights that come from the decoder features, so local continuity and wider context are used together. An auxiliary segmentation branch adds region-level supervision and keeps the overlap accuracy high. On the retinal vessel dataset DRIVE and the crack inspection dataset DeepCrack, TMAL reaches the highest Dice, IoU, and clDice scores, and it greatly reduces the connected-component error $Δβ_0$. Code is available at https://github.com/suho-han/TMAL.

papers.title: When Reconstruction Helps Event-Camera Person Triggers
papers.brief: 比较事件相机的直接编码与强度重建，用于视觉模型触发人员录像；E2VID在相同误报上限下显著提高检出率，但连续触发仍需权衡处理成本与误启动。
papers.tldr: 比较事件相机的直接编码与强度重建，用于视觉模型触发人员录像；E2VID在相同误报上限下显著提高检出率，但连续触发仍需权衡处理成本与误启动。
papers.abstract: Event cameras record asynchronous changes in brightness. To use a general visual model as a recording trigger, a system must represent these measurements in a form the model can interpret. We compare direct grayscale accumulation, two temporal encodings, and two intensity reconstructors on paired real event data. On 192 windows from four held-out DSEC recordings, thresholds calibrated only on development data yielded 40 of 52 person detections and 12 of 140 background positives with E2VID. The strongest direct temporal encoding at an admissible fixed cutoff yielded 14 detections and seven background positives. A retrospective comparison at a common 10% background-positive cap yielded 40 detections for E2VID and at most 19 for any direct encoding. FireNet+ had lower preparation cost and produced 21 detections with zero observed background positives at its frozen cutoff. On the same 192 windows, Qwen3-VL-4B yielded 33/52, 2/140 with E2VID and 9/52, 9/140 with the highest-recall direct rendering, the three-bin image (person detections, background positives). A 96-second exploratory replay illustrates the sensitivity of episode capture and recording starts to cutoff selection. The experiments identify a detection benefit from reconstruction under controlled input history and distinguish it from the cost and false starts of continuous triggering.

papers.title: Hand-Object Contact Transition Detection in Egocentric Video
papers.brief: 提出联合建模手与物体的框架，定位第一视角视频中的接触与释放时刻，并构建标注数据集；两类检测均优于强基线，可辅助下游交互推理。
papers.tldr: 提出联合建模手与物体的框架，定位第一视角视频中的接触与释放时刻，并构建标注数据集；两类检测均优于强基线，可辅助下游交互推理。
papers.abstract: This paper tackles the task of hand-object contact transition detection in egocentric video, which aims to localize the two temporal boundaries of a contact episode: the moment a hand first establishes contact with an object (touch) and the moment contact is released (release). We propose a unified framework that jointly models the interacting hand and object to accurately localize both transition types. The proposed framework augments hand-centric spatiotemporal representations with object-aware features learned directly from the video and introduces a transition-aware event spotting formulation tailored to contact transitions, without relying on external object or hand-object interaction detectors during inference. To support this task, we present ContactTransition, a dataset comprising 4,021 egocentric videos with 8,498 touch and 8,077 release annotations, together with object-of-interest supervision. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms strong two-stage and end-to-end event-spotting baselines on both transition types. Finally, we show that detected contact transitions provide effective temporal anchors for downstream egocentric hand-object reasoning.
